about: Families ride the NOELevator at the Oshkosh Food Co-op for a trip to the North Pole in Skyway to Santa.
Time slots start Saturday, December 12, 2026, and run through Sunday, December 20, at 155 Jackson St.
Each visit is a 15-minute experience for groups of up to 12, with time to share wish lists with Santa, take photos, make crafts and pick up treats and giveaways.
Admission is free, and donations support the co-op's Food for All program.
